external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: People who sign in through the identity broker, including franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
external_entities.notes: Colleagues sign in from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies colleague group membership changes and leaver information overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider used by franchise colleagues to vouch for their identities.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The source does not identify which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, supplies the public signing key, pulls directory changes, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: Tokens are valid for twelve hours and cannot be revoked before expiry. The broker accepts the franchise identity provider as a sign-in. It is not documented whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application on the corporate network that allows a holder of a token containing the store-manager group to change prices and void transactions across every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to.

data_stores.name: key store

data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Group membership is supplied from the HR system overnight.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: The log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. Nobody has written down whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign-in

data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token carrying the colleague's staff id and group list.

data_flows.name: keep signing key

data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker updates its directory with colleague and group information from overnight HR changes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group membership and leaver changes from the HR system once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues and the identity broker accepts that as a sign-in.

data_flows.notes: The source does not specify which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.
